children: ASPAC II Acquisition issued a $500,000 unsecured, non-interest-bearing promissory note to its sponsor, A SPAC II Holdings. The note is payable no later than the closing of the company's initial business combination, and the sponsor may convert it into warrants on the same terms as the public warrants at $1 per warrant. Proceeds will fund company expenses and working capital.
